status_note: Virtual-dispatch routing fixture: Datatype::get_sub_type routes the Spacebase arm to TypeSpacebase::get_sub_type (type.cc:2947 scope query) exactly as the C++ virtual call from TypePointer::isPtrsubMatching (type.cc:1129) does; 7 of 10 records MATCH. The 3 remaining records pin the pre-existing no-container fallback divergence TYPE-SPACEBASE-MISSFALLBACK-0001: Ghidra returns glb->types->getBase(1,TYPE_UNKNOWN) with newoff=0, Rugra returns None because its type layer has no TypeFactory handle on TypeSpacebase.

decisive_semantics.reference_and_output_parameters: getSubType(int8 off, int8* newoff) returns the component Datatype* and writes the renormalized offset through the out-pointer; isPtrsubMatching(int8,int8,int8) is const, value-only. Rugra mirrors with (Option<Arc<Datatype>>, i64) tuples; the Arc is the canonical factory/scope-owned object, mirroring the C++ pointer identity.
decisive_semantics.loop_boundaries_and_iteration_order: ScopeInternal::findContainer walks the address rangemap from the last entry starting at-or-before addr downward (database.cc:2255-2274), keeping the strictly smallest containing entry; getMap returns the global scope, or the function-local scope when localframe is valid (type.cc:2938-2943). Rugra find_container mirrors the same last-start descending scan with smallest-size preference; get_map returns the stored scope reference.
decisive_semantics.counters_accumulators_and_scope: No counters; the renormalized offset is computed once per call as (addr.getOffset() - smallest->getAddr().getOffset()) + smallest->getOffset() (type.cc:2967).
decisive_semantics.sorting_and_comparison_keys: findContainer prefers strictly smaller entry.getSize() with the -1 sentinel for first-accept (database.cc:2267-2271); isPtrsubMatching bounds are extra < 0 || extra >= subType->getSize() with testForArraySlack fallback; renormalized newoff must equal 0 at the gate (type.cc:1130).

observation_schema.format: key=value lines; sub-type records serialize as <metaname>:<size>:<renormalized offset>, gate records as 0/1

getsubtype_symbol_hit_and_mid_offset.covers: subtype.hit_start, subtype.hit_mid — virtual dispatch reaches the scope query and returns the symbol container type with renormalized offsets 0 and 8

getsubtype_miss_unknown_fallback.covers: subtype.miss_gap, subtype.hit_endboundary — Ghidra returns getBase(1,TYPE_UNKNOWN) with newoff=0; Rugra returns None from the same no-container branch

isptrsub_matching_spacebase_gate_in_symb.covers: gate.hit_extra0, gate.hit_extra8, gate.hit_extra16, gate.midsym — extra bounds against the container size and the renormalized-newoff-0 requirement

isptrsub_matching_unmapped_extra_zero.covers: gate.miss_extra0 — Ghidra's UNKNOWN fallback type (size 1) admits extra==0, Rugra's None does not

isptrsub_matching_unmapped_extra_out_of_.covers: gate.miss_extra8 — extra beyond the fallback type size is rejected on both sides
